criteria.check: Checked src/cma/verify.py (_verify_run:185-222, _verify_pack:228-290, _compare:103-125, _compare_months:128-155, _check_shape:305-334), src/cma/overrides.py:371-419, and src/cma/cli.py:936-987 against R44 and runner logs (contracts-4.log:1068-1090, invariants-5.log:1070-1085). Failed due to 3 major defects: unrecorded accounts imported after sign-off pollute pack recomputation, bool/number type confusion hides tampered values, and malformed record shapes crash with unhandled exceptions or wrong override slicing.

Checked src/cma/verify.py:_check_ruleset (lines 63-80) and verify() (lines 357-360), src/cma/graph.py:492 (package_version), src/cma/pack.py:656 (package_version), and src/cma/cli.py:953-972. Both unknown ruleset ids and sha256 mismatches are refused before recomputation naming package_version, ruleset id, and sha256; confirmed passing in contracts-4.log:1074-1076,1080.

Checked src/cma/overrides.py:371-468 (case_figures caches _PARSED, _CLASSES, _BARE keyed purely on unoverridden inputs) and tests/test_verify.py:118-133 + tests/test_overrides.py:76-120. Confirmed test_p3_figures_twice_and_overrides_one_at_a_time_equal_a_fresh_computation passed in invariants-5.log:1073 and full suite passed in specified-3.log (2935 passed).

Checked src/cma/verify.py:_verify_pack (lines 228-290) and src/cma/overrides.py:385-414 against P13 and invariants-5.log:1070-1085. While existing tests pass when no new account is added after sign-off, importing another account into the case after sign-off leaves all recorded inputs intact yet causes verify() to run pair_own_accounts against the unrecorded account and report mismatches on the signed pack.

findings.claim: _verify_pack recomputes via overrides.case_figures(folder, ...) over every account currently in the case log instead of restricting to inputs['statements']. Importing a second account into a case after a 1-account pack was signed off causes pair_own_accounts to mutate the signed account's categories/figures and appends Mismatch('account <new>', 'not recorded', 'recomputed'), failing verification (exit 1) on an untampered signed pack whose recorded inputs are all unchanged.
findings.repro: Create a case, import account 'main', build preview and sign off to produce evidence.json (inputs.statements == {'main': sha}). Then run store.import_file(folder, savings_csv, 'csv', account='savings') and call verify.verify(ev, case_folder=folder). Even with main.csv, case.yaml, firm_rules.yaml, and overrides.jsonl unchanged, verify returns Mismatch('account savings', 'not recorded', 'recomputed') plus any mismatches on 'main' caused by cross-account own-account pairing.

findings.claim: _compare (line 118) and _compare_months (lines 142, 148) compare recorded and recomputed values with plain Python !=, where True == 1.0, False == 0.0, 0 == False, and 1 == True. Tampering numeric figures or monthly cells with booleans, or part_month with 0/1, silently passes verification with zero mismatches.
findings.repro: Load examples/cafe_stretched.memo.evidence.json (where M7 value is 1.0, M13 value is 0.0, monthly_summary[0]['part_month'] is False, and days_overdrawn value is 0). Replace M7['value'] = True, M13['value'] = False, monthly_summary[0]['part_month'] = 0, and monthly_summary[0]['days_overdrawn']['value'] = False. Run verify.verify(ev, base=EXAMPLE.parent) or `cma verify`: returns mismatches == [] and exit code 0.

findings.claim: _check_shape misses multiple malformed evidence record shapes, refuting claim #1 and causing unhandled exceptions (traceback, exit 1) or silent wrong override slicing instead of VerifyRefused (exit 2): (1) {'accounts': None} crashes with TypeError at verify.py:318; (2) non-dict monthly cells (e.g. 'money_in': 500.0 or '500.00') crash with TypeError/AttributeError at verify.py:147-148; (3) non-dict inputs.statements or inputs.override_log crashes with AttributeError at verify.py:247/261, non-int inputs.own_account_pairing_days crashes with TypeError in pair_own_accounts, and bool/negative/non-int inputs.override_log.position (True, False, -1, None) silently slices records[:1]/records[:0]/records[:-1] or applies post-sign-off overrides at overrides.py:388-392; (4) malformed money_in.total/cash_within_trading (e.g. {'id': ['M17']} or 'bad') crashes with TypeError at verify.py:113 or reports a mismatch (exit 1).
findings.repro: 1) Run `cma verify` on {**example, 'accounts': None} -> unhandled TypeError at src/cma/verify.py:318. 2) Set example['monthly_summary'][0]['money_in'] = 500.0 and run `cma verify` -> unhandled TypeError at src/cma/verify.py:147. 3) On a signed pack evidence.json, set ev['inputs']['override_log'] = {'position': -1} (with 2 overrides in case) -> overrides.py:392 slices records[:-1] instead of refusing; or set ev['inputs']['override_log'] = 'bad' -> unhandled AttributeError at verify.py:261; or set ev['accounts'][0]['money_in']['total'] = {'id': ['M17']} -> unhandled TypeError at verify.py:113.

findings.claim: _verify_run skips statement SHA-256 verification when statement.sha256 is null, empty string, or absent (`if recorded.get('sha256') and sha != recorded['sha256']:`), allowing a tampered v1 `cma run` record with its statement hash stripped to be verified against any substituted CSV file instead of refusing.
findings.repro: Take a v1 `cma run` evidence record, delete ev['statement']['sha256'] (or set it to None or ''), edit the statement CSV on disk (or pass a different CSV with --statement), and run verify.verify(ev, base=...). Instead of VerifyRefused, it recomputes from the unverified file.

findings.claim: _compare, _compare_months, and _verify_pack do not reject duplicate metric ids, bucket ids, months, or accounts in the recorded JSON, and _buckets flattens total/buckets/cash_within_trading by id. Duplicating an identical metric/bucket/month/account entry or moving M17 from money_in.total into money_in.buckets verifies with zero mismatches and inflated checked counts.
findings.repro: On a valid signed pack evidence.json, duplicate ev['accounts'][0]['metrics'][0] (M1) or move ev['accounts'][0]['money_in']['total'] into ev['accounts'][0]['money_in']['buckets'] and set total=None. verify.verify(ev, case_folder=folder) returns mismatches == [] with checked['figures'] == 29.
